text.en:
Any commodity not ineluded in any previous
Executive Order fixing ceiling prices and issued by author
ity of Republic Act No. 509 or in this Order, the size and
specification of which are the same as those of the fore-
going shall have the same ceiling price.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 6th day of October, in
the year of Our Lord nineteen hundred and fifty, and of
the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philipines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
